question: A patient presented with deep skull wound, surgeon should be careful in suturing which layer that if not properly sutured leave behind large gap and also improve in granulation tissue formation?
explanation: The tension of the epicranial aponeurosis, produced by the tone of the occipitofrontalis muscles, is important in all deep wounds of the scalp. If the aponeurosis has been divided, the wound will gape open. For satisfactory healing to take place, the opening in the aponeurosis must be closed with sutures.
